entries.root_cause: The initial-validation completion path checked source generation/configuration/scope/binding/provider authority in one READ COMMITTED statement and only acquired the source row lock later during the final source UPDATE. A concurrent configuration or scope edit could therefore commit between the authority check and the dependent write, allowing stale validation evidence to be persisted and applied to newly configured source state.
horizontal_audit: worker completion paths that validate revision or generation before a later mutation
compare-and-swap and fencing logic implemented as separate check and update statements
provider synchronization completion and reconciliation paths
tenant and authority transitions whose validity must remain stable through persistence
future host inventory, metric, problem and current-state ingestion commits
